summary: Diageo plc furnished a routine Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) bundling September 2026 London Stock Exchange disclosures: a Total Voting Rights notice showing 2,432,397,125 ordinary shares issued and 2,226,657,196 voting rights as of 31 August 2026, multiple Director/PDMR shareholding notifications, and publication of a prospectus dated 7 September 2026 renewing the group's European debt issuance programme for Diageo plc as guarantor and Diageo Finance plc and Diageo Capital B.V. as issuers. No M&A, capital-return, activist or management-change event is disclosed; the debt instruments are unregistered and not offered in the US.
